app.tagline: Purge every DWG and DXF drawing in a folder.
welcome.notice.title: Before you start
welcome.notice.body: PurgeCAD changes your drawings. It is free software and comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY, to the extent permitted by law (GNU GPL v3, sections 15 and 16). You use it at your own risk: keep backups of your drawings and check the results before you rely on them.
welcome.notice.accept: I have read this and I accept it
source.filter.tip: Only drawings whose name contains one of the words. Separate several with commas; * and ? are wildcards; -word leaves those names out. Case and diacritics do not matter.
scan.none: No drawings found in this folder.
options.dangerous: Removes geometry, not only unused definitions
options.allowUnknown: Also purge drawings with objects ACadSharp cannot keep
options.allowUnknown.risk: Risky: those objects (visual styles, associative dimensions, data from other programs) are removed from the copy. Use only for testing, and check the result in AutoCAD.
engine.auto.name: Automatic
engine.autocad.name: AutoCAD
engine.acadsharp.name: ACadSharp
engine.autocad.risk.newerFiles: Cannot open drawings newer than the installed AutoCAD; they are skipped.
engine.autocad.risk.windowsOnly: Windows only, needs full AutoCAD (not AutoCAD LT).
engine.autocad.unavailable.os: Not available on this operating system.
engine.autocad.unavailable.notFound: AutoCAD was not found on this computer.
engine.acadsharp.risk.rewrite: Rewrites the whole file with an open-source library.
engine.acadsharp.risk.unknownObjects: Objects it does not understand (proxy objects, data from other programs) may be lost. Such files are skipped by default.
engine.acadsharp.risk.dwg2007: Cannot save DWG 2007 files; they are skipped or saved as DWG 2010.
engine.autocad.binaryDxf: Binary DXF files are not supported by the AutoCAD engine.
engine.autocad.fail.noOutput: AutoCAD did not save the purged drawing.
engine.autocad.fail.license: AutoCAD could not start its licence (Unable to initialize adlm). Open AutoCAD once normally, then try again with 1 file at a time.
engine.autocad.fail.stuck: AutoCAD stopped responding (no output for 2 minutes), probably waiting for an answer. Hover for the last lines it printed.
engine.autocad.fail.cannotOpen: AutoCAD could not open this file (it is damaged, or was made by a program AutoCAD does not accept). Nothing was saved; try the ACadSharp engine.
engine.autocad.risk.categories: Annotation scales: the scale list is reset to AutoCAD's defaults; scales in use are kept.
output.copy.hint: Originals stay untouched. Subfolders are kept.
output.inPlace.hint: Each original is first copied to _purgecad-backup.
output.reportOnly.hint: Shows what would be removed and how much space it would free. Nothing is saved.
output.replace.hint: Overwrites each original with the purged version. No backup is kept.
output.replace.confirm.title: Replace the originals?
output.replace.confirm.body: {count} drawings will be overwritten with their purged versions. No backup is kept and this cannot be undone.
skip.locked: The file is in use by another program.
skip.openElsewhere: The drawing is open in a CAD program.
skip.versionTooNew: The drawing is newer than this AutoCAD can open.
skip.unknownObjects: The drawing contains objects ACadSharp does not understand.
skip.dwg2007: DWG 2007 files cannot be saved by ACadSharp.
fail.timeout: Took too long and was stopped.
fail.corrupt: The file is damaged and cannot be read.
fail.verify: The result did not pass verification; the original was kept.
results.title: Results
results.empty: Choose a folder and press Start. Each drawing appears here with its result.
summary.estimateNote: Estimate only, nothing was saved. Each drawing was written to a temporary copy with the selected engine, measured and deleted.
cleanup.lock.hint: Only when the drawing is not open anywhere.
cleanup.bak.hint: AutoCAD's only automatic backup of the previous save.
cleanup.alsoDuringPurge: Also clean auxiliary files during the purge
cleanup.confirm.title: Remove these files?
cleanup.confirm.body: {count} files, {size}. They go to the Recycle Bin / Trash.
cleanup.confirm.bodyPermanent: {count} files, {size}. They will be deleted permanently.
cleanup.networkNote: On network drives there is no Recycle Bin: files were moved to _purgecad-deleted.
cleanup.description: Removes the lock, backup and autosave files left next to drawings. The drawings themselves are not touched.
cloud.note: Tip: pause Dropbox / OneDrive sync during large runs.
about.title: About PurgeCAD
update.body.install: Installs in a few seconds; PurgeCAD restarts. Your settings are kept.
update.body.download: This copy was not installed with the setup, so it cannot update itself. Download the new version from its page.
update.afterRun: Available when the files being processed are done.
update.failed: The update could not be installed. Try again later, or download it from the page.
update.unknown: Version {version}. Could not check for updates (offline?).
update.auto: Check for updates when PurgeCAD starts
about.noWarranty: This program comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY. Keep backups of your drawings.
about.autodesk: AutoCAD is a registered trademark of Autodesk, Inc. PurgeCAD is not affiliated with Autodesk.
about.value.license: GNU GPL v3 with additional terms
engine.autocad.saveVersionTooNew: This AutoCAD cannot save in the chosen version (it is older).
engine.acadsharp.saveVersion2007: ACadSharp cannot save DWG 2007. Choose 2004 or 2010.
engine.auto.fallback: When AutoCAD cannot open a file, ACadSharp tries it.
results.engine.fallback.tip: {first} could not do this file, so {engine} did it.
category.MissingReferences.hint: Detaches xrefs, images and PDF / DWF / DGN underlays whose file no longer exists. AutoCAD only.
category.MissingReferences.autocadOnly: Missing references are detached only by AutoCAD; ACadSharp leaves them.
options.what.optInNote: Highlighted items stay off until you tick them.
saveAs.title: Save as
saveAs.tip: Save in another DWG / DXF version. Applies to the ticked files: tick one to convert only that one.
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.tip: Save the options under a name and switch with one click
profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Set the options, then save them here.
profiles.name: Profile name
profiles.saveHint: Saves the engine, what to purge, the version, where to save and the folder filters. The same name replaces it.
convert.hint: Nothing is purged: the drawings are only saved in this DWG / DXF version. Those already in it are left as they are.
convert.engineHint: AutoCAD keeps everything in the drawing. ACadSharp cannot write DWG 2007.
about.whatsNew.empty: The release notes could not be loaded. Are you offline?
help.title: Something went wrong with a drawing?
help.text: Send us the log of that drawing: it helps us a lot to find out what happened. After a run, click Show log next to the file, then attach that log when you report the problem.
help.private: A log lists file and folder names and what was removed, never the drawing itself. Remove anything private before you send it, and never attach a client's drawing.
help.report.tip: Opens a new issue on GitHub with your version and system filled in (you need a GitHub account).
support.title: Free and open source, now and always
support.share: The best way to help: tell your colleagues and friends about PurgeCAD, and mention it on forums, in groups and on your social networks. Every recommendation helps us keep building free tools for everyone.
support.money: And if you'd like to support our work directly, you can do it on
